static Interval mult(Interval a, Interval b) {
  if (a.empty || b.empty) return EMPTY;
  if (a.isZero() || b.isZero()) return const(ZERO);
  if (a.isTop()) return b.isZero()? const(ZERO): TOP; // b zero handled
  if (b.isTop()) return TOP;
  boolean loNull = false, hiNull = false;
  // a unbounded below
  if (a.lo == null) {
    if (hasPositive(b)) loNull = true;
    if (hasNegative(b)) hiNull = true;
  }
  if (a.hi == null) {
    if (hasNegative(b)) loNull = true;
    if (hasPositive(b)) hiNull = true;
  }
  // b unbounded below
  if (b.lo == null) {
    if (hasPositive(a)) loNull = true;
    if (hasNegative(a)) hiNull = true;
  }
  if (b.hi == null) {
    if (hasNegative(a)) loNull = true;
    if (hasPositive(a)) hiNull = true;
  }
  BigInteger min = null, max = null;
  // finite endpoints
  BigInteger[] aEnds = {a.lo, a.hi}; BigInteger[] bEnds = {b.lo, b.hi};
  for (BigInteger x : aEnds) if (x != null) for (BigInteger y : bEnds) if (y != null) {
     BigInteger p = x.multiply(y);
     if (min == null || p.compareTo(min) < 0) min = p;
     if (max == null || p.compareTo(max) > 0) max = p;
  }
  // If no finite endpoints (both top) but non-zero, loNull/hiNull should be true.
  if (loNull) return new Interval(false, null, hiNull ? null : max);
  if (hiNull) return new Interval(false, loNull ? null : min, null);
  return of(min, max);
}

private static IntervalResult computeIntervals(List<Ineq> constraints) {
  Map<String, Interval> intervals = new HashMap<>();
  for (Ineq c : constraints) for (String v : c.coeffs.keySet()) intervals.put(v, Interval.top());
  final int MAX_ITER = 100;
  for (int iter=0; iter<MAX_ITER; iter++) {
    boolean changed = false;
    for (Ineq c : constraints) {
      // total min
      BigInteger totalMin = null;
      for (Map.Entry<String,BigInteger> e : c.coeffs.entrySet()) {
         Interval iv = intervals.get(e.getKey());
         if (iv == null || iv.empty) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
         BigInteger termMin = minTerm(e.getValue(), iv);
         totalMin = addNull(totalMin, termMin);
      }
      if (totalMin != null && totalMin.compareTo(c.rhs) > 0) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
      // per var
      for (Map.Entry<String,BigInteger> e : c.coeffs.entrySet()) {
         String var = e.getKey(); BigInteger cvar = e.getValue();
         if (cvar.signum()==0) continue;
         BigInteger restMin = BigInteger.ZERO;
         boolean inf = false;
         for (Map.Entry<String,BigInteger> e2 : c.coeffs.entrySet()) {
            if (e2.getKey().equals(var)) continue;
            Interval iv2 = intervals.get(e2.getKey());
            if (iv2 == null || iv2.empty) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
            BigInteger termMin2 = minTerm(e2.getValue(), iv2);
            if (termMin2 == null) { inf = true; break; }
            restMin = restMin.add(termMin2);
         }
         if (inf) continue;
         BigInteger num = c.rhs.subtract(restMin);
         Interval iv = intervals.get(var);
         BigInteger lo = iv.lo, hi = iv.hi;
         if (cvar.signum() > 0) {
            BigInteger bound = num.floorDiv(cvar);
            if (hi == null || bound.compareTo(hi) < 0) { hi = bound; changed = true; }
         } else {
            BigInteger bound = ceilDiv(num, cvar);
            if (lo == null || bound.compareTo(lo) > 0) { lo = bound; changed = true; }
         }
         if (lo != null && hi != null && lo.compareTo(hi) > 0) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
         Interval newIv = Interval.of(lo, hi);
         if (!newIv.equals(iv)) { intervals.put(var, newIv); changed = true; }
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  return new IntervalResult(intervals, false);
}

static State of(List<Ineq> ineqs) {
  List<Ineq> normalized = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Ineq ineq : ineqs) {
    Ineq n = ineq.normalize();
    if (n == null) continue;
    if (n.isBottom()) return BOTTOM;
    normalized.add(n);

  if (normalized.isEmpty()) return TOP;
  // sort unique
  normalized.sort(Comparator.comparing(Ineq::toString));
  List<Ineq> unique = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Ineq ineq : normalized) if (!unique.contains(ineq)) unique.add(ineq);
  IntervalResult res = computeIntervals(unique);
  if (res.infeasible) return BOTTOM;
  boolean relational = false;
  for (Ineq ineq : unique) if (ineq.coeffs.size() > 1) { relational = true; break; }
  return new State(false, unique, res.intervals, relational);
}

static Ineq normalize(Map<String,BigInteger> coeffs, BigInteger rhs) {
  Map<String,BigInteger> m = new HashMap<>();
  for (e : coeffs.entrySet()) if (e.getValue().signum()!=0) m.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
  if (m.isEmpty()) {
    if (rhs.signum() < 0) return BOTTOM_INEQ;
    return null;
  }
  BigInteger g = BigInteger.ZERO;
  for (BigInteger v : m.values()) g = g.gcd(v.abs());
  g = g.gcd(rhs.abs());
  if (g.signum() > 1) {
    Map<String,BigInteger> dm = new HashMap<>();
    for (e : m.entrySet()) dm.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue().divide(g));
    BigInteger dr = rhs.divide(g);
    return new Ineq(dm, dr);
  }
  return new Ineq(m, rhs);
}
```

```
private static List<Ineq> project(List<Ineq> constraints, String x) {
  List<Ineq> zero = new ArrayList<>();
  List<PosNeg> pos = new ArrayList<>();
  List<PosNeg> neg = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Ineq c : constraints) {
    BigInteger cx = c.coeff(x);
    if (cx.signum() == 0) zero.add(c);
    else {
      Map<String,BigInteger> exprCoeffs = new HashMap<>(c.coeffs);
      exprCoeffs.remove(x);
      LinExpr expr = new LinExpr(exprCoeffs, ZERO);
      if (cx.signum() > 0) pos.add(new PosNeg(cx, expr, c.rhs));
      else neg.add(new PosNeg(cx.negate(), expr, c.rhs));
    }
  }
  if (pos.isEmpty() || neg.isEmpty()) return zero;
  long pairs = (long)pos.size() * (long)neg.size();
  if (pairs + zero.size() > MAX_PROJ_CONSTRAINTS) return zero;
  List<Ineq> result = new ArrayList<>(zero);
  for (PosNeg p : pos) {
    for (PosNeg n : neg) {
      LinExpr lhs = n.expr.scale(p.a).add(p.expr.scale(n.c));
      BigInteger rhs = n.rhs.scale(p.a).add(p.rhs.scale(n.c));
      Ineq ineq = lhs.toIneq(rhs);
      if (ineq != null) {
        if (ineq.isBottom()) return List.of(Ineq.bottom());
        result.add(ineq);
        if (result.size() > MAX_PROJ_CONSTRAINTS) return zero;
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```

static Interval mult(Interval a, Interval b) {
  if (a.empty || b.empty) return EMPTY;
  if (a.isZero() || b.isZero()) return const(ZERO);
  if (a.isTop()) return b.isZero()? const(ZERO): TOP; // b zero handled
  if (b.isTop()) return TOP;
  boolean loNull = false, hiNull = false;
  // a unbounded below
  if (a.lo == null) {
    if (hasPositive(b)) loNull = true;
    if (hasNegative(b)) hiNull = true;
  }
  if (a.hi == null) {
    if (hasNegative(b)) loNull = true;
    if (hasPositive(b)) hiNull = true;
  }
  // b unbounded below
  if (b.lo == null) {
    if (hasPositive(a)) loNull = true;
    if (hasNegative(a)) hiNull = true;
  }
  if (b.hi == null) {
    if (hasNegative(a)) loNull = true;
    if (hasPositive(a)) hiNull = true;
  }
  BigInteger min = null, max = null;
  // finite endpoints
  BigInteger[] aEnds = {a.lo, a.hi}; BigInteger[] bEnds = {b.lo, b.hi};
  for (BigInteger x : aEnds) if (x != null) for (BigInteger y : bEnds) if (y != null) {
     BigInteger p = x.multiply(y);
     if (min == null || p.compareTo(min) < 0) min = p;
     if (max == null || p.compareTo(max) > 0) max = p;

  if (loNull) return new Interval(false, null, hiNull ? null : max);
  if (hiNull) return new Interval(false, loNull ? null : min, null);
  return of(min, max);
}

private static IntervalResult computeIntervals(List<Ineq> constraints) {
  Map<String, Interval> intervals = new HashMap<>();
  for (Ineq c : constraints) for (String v : c.coeffs.keySet()) intervals.put(v, Interval.top());
  final int MAX_ITER = 100;
  for (int iter=0; iter<MAX_ITER; iter++) {
    boolean changed = false;
    for (Ineq c : constraints) {
      // total min
      BigInteger totalMin = null;
      for (Map.Entry<String,BigInteger> e : c.coeffs.entrySet()) {
         Interval iv = intervals.get(e.getKey());
         if (iv == null || iv.empty) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
         BigInteger termMin = minTerm(e.getValue(), iv);
         totalMin = addNull(totalMin, termMin);
      }
      if (totalMin != null && totalMin.compareTo(c.rhs) > 0) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
      // per var
      for (Map.Entry<String,BigInteger> e : c.coeffs.entrySet()) {
         String var = e.getKey(); BigInteger cvar = e.getValue();
         if (cvar.signum()==0) continue;
         BigInteger restMin = BigInteger.ZERO;
         boolean inf = false;
         for (Map.Entry<String,BigInteger> e2 : c.coeffs.entrySet()) {
            if (e2.getKey().equals(var)) continue;
            Interval iv2 = intervals.get(e2.getKey());
            if (iv2 == null || iv2.empty) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
            BigInteger termMin2 = minTerm(e2.getValue(), iv2);
            if (termMin2 == null) { inf = true; break; }
            restMin = restMin.add(termMin2);
         }
         if (inf) continue;
         BigInteger num = c.rhs.subtract(restMin);
         Interval iv = intervals.get(var);
         BigInteger lo = iv.lo, hi = iv.hi;
         if (cvar.signum() > 0) {
            BigInteger bound = num.floorDiv(cvar);
            if (hi == null || bound.compareTo(hi) < 0) { hi = bound; changed = true; }
         } else {
            BigInteger bound = ceilDiv(num, cvar);
            if (lo == null || bound.compareTo(lo) > 0) { lo = bound; changed = true; }
         }
         if (lo != null && hi != null && lo.compareTo(hi) > 0) return new IntervalResult(null, true);
         Interval newIv = Interval.of(lo, hi);
         if (!newIv.equals(iv)) { intervals.put(var, newIv); changed = true; }
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  return new IntervalResult(intervals, false);
}

static Ineq normalize(Map<String,BigInteger> coeffs, BigInteger rhs) {
  Map<String,BigInteger> m = new HashMap<>();
  for (e : coeffs.entrySet()) if (e.getValue().signum()!=0) m.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
  if (m.isEmpty()) {
    if (rhs.signum() < 0) return BOTTOM_INEQ;
    return null;
  }
  BigInteger g = BigInteger.ZERO;
  for (BigInteger v : m.values()) g = g.gcd(v.abs());
  g = g.gcd(rhs.abs());
  if (g.signum() > 1) {
    Map<String,BigInteger> dm = new HashMap<>();
    for (e : m.entrySet()) dm.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue().divide(g));
    BigInteger dr = rhs.divide(g);
    return new Ineq(dm, dr);
  }
  return new Ineq(m, rhs);
}

```
private static List<Ineq> project(List<Ineq> constraints, String x) {
  List<Ineq> zero = new ArrayList<>();
  List<PosNeg> pos = new ArrayList<>();
  List<PosNeg> neg = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Ineq c : constraints) {
    BigInteger cx = c.coeff(x);
    if (cx.signum() == 0) zero.add(c);
    else {
      Map<String,BigInteger> exprCoeffs = new HashMap<>(c.coeffs);
      exprCoeffs.remove(x);
      LinExpr expr = new LinExpr(exprCoeffs, ZERO);
      if (cx.signum() > 0) pos.add(new PosNeg(cx, expr, c.rhs));
      else neg.add(new PosNeg(cx.negate(), expr, c.rhs));
    }
  }
  if (pos.isEmpty() || neg.isEmpty()) return zero;
  long pairs = (long)pos.size() * (long)neg.size();
  if (pairs + zero.size() > MAX_PROJ_CONSTRAINTS) return zero;
  List<Ineq> result = new ArrayList<>(zero);
  for (PosNeg p : pos) {
    for (PosNeg n : neg) {
      LinExpr lhs = n.expr.scale(p.a).add(p.expr.scale(n.c));
      BigInteger rhs = n.rhs.scale(p.a).add(p.rhs.scale(n.c));
      Ineq ineq = lhs.toIneq(rhs);
      if (ineq != null) {
        if (ineq.isBottom()) return List.of(Ineq.bottom());
        result.add(ineq);
        if (result.size() > MAX_PROJ_CONSTRAINTS) return zero;
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```
